_doc: Manual corrections applied after parsing. Every entry records a human decision about a defect in the source PDF, so the parser stays free of special cases and each judgement is auditable.

strict_disagreements._doc: Disposition of every id strict.py has ever reported as a book-vs-HRS disagreement, decided 9 Aug 2026 (P2-0004). Each is either 'flag' (a real disagreement, surfaced in the quiz via notes_*.json flag:check/conflict) or 'mapping-bug' (the two questions are not actually the same question; fixed in strict.py's matcher, not in the data). Full reasoning in REVIEW.md §2.

teh-201.reason: 75Ω→300Ω match transformer 'omjer transformacije': book/RK zbirka answer 1:2 is the TURNS ratio, HRS's 1:4 is the IMPEDANCE ratio (n=√4=2, Z-ratio=4). Both numerically correct for their own reading of an ambiguous term; not a numbering error, not a legal question. Flagged check so a student who computes 1:2 from physics is not left thinking they were wrong.

teh-273.reason: Filter to suppress subharmonics AND harmonics after a VHF transmitter: HRS marks (d) niskopropusni, book/RK's own zbirka answer table marks (b) pojasnopropusni. A low-pass filter passes everything below the working frequency, so it cannot suppress a subharmonic by definition — RK's own running text (str. 192–193) agrees with its zbirka, not with HRS. Two independent RK sources against one HRS red mark. Answer HRS in the exam; flagged check so the reader also gets the physically correct answer.

pro-090.flag_set_in: notes_zz_currency.json (pre-existing, from the 9 Aug currency audit)
pro-090.reason: Inspection powers (trajna zabrana rada vs. privremena zabrana 3–12 mj.) are not in NN 150/22 at all — 'zabrana' does not occur in the Pravilnik; those powers live in ZEK NN 76/22, which is outside the audited source set. This strict.py disagreement is the SAME root cause as the pro-069/pro-087–pro-092 currency-audit cluster (REVIEW.md §2) and was already flagged check by that audit before this item ran. No new action — recorded here only so the strict.py residue is accounted for.

pro-047.reason: 135,7–137,8 kHz is A-razred only under Dodatak 1, Tablica 1 (the string does not appear in the P-razred table); HRS marks 'A i P razreda'. Already flagged conflict before this item ran; the book independently corroborates the Pravilnik reading, which strengthens the existing flag but the flag and its warning prose are untouched per this item's Avoid clause.

prv-009.reason: HRS prv-009 asks about LSB, book bk-pra-5-05 asks about USB — two genuinely different questions (different KV segments use different sidebands by convention) that happen to share a template stem and the same four band options. The stems score >=0.90 on plain similarity (one 3-letter run differs out of ~60 chars), so the old matcher paired them and reported a fake key disagreement. strict.py now requires any emission-mode abbreviation (USB/LSB/CW/AM/...) present in either raw stem to match before accepting a pair. Both HRS and book answers are correct for their own question; this pair is no longer counted as comparable (108->107 total), which is why the agreement percentage rose to 96.3% — a fixed mismatch, not a loosened check.

Its options are lettered e)-h), so the parser folded them into question 186, which ended up with eight options and two red marks. Verified against the rendered page.

figure_options._doc: Questions whose OPTIONS are diagrams rather than text. The red mark still identifies the answer; the option bodies are supplied as cropped images. The four labels MUST be listed explicitly: text extraction only finds whichever labels happen to sit on a text baseline, which left teh-074 offering a) and c) alone while its correct answer was b) — unanswerable. WARNING: the answers here are typed in by hand, and three of the original four were typed WRONG (see the per-question reasons). Never take one on trust; read the red label off the rendered page. To re-check all four at once, list the coloured spans that fall between a question's stem and the next question's stem.

teh-075.reason: Was 'c'. The red label on str. 12 is (d) — the response flat to 3 kHz then rolling off, i.e. the low-pass a microphone stage wants. Option (c) is a U-shaped curve. Physics and the red mark agree; the 'c' was a transcription slip when these four were hand-entered.

teh-095.reason: Was 'a'. The red label on str. 14 is b) — separated positive humps with gaps, which is what a half-wave rectifier actually produces. Option (a) is an un-rectified full sine.

teh-114.reason: Was 'a'. The red label on str. 16 is (c) — the modulation trapezoid whose edge runs past the apex, the signature of over 100 % modulation. Option (a) is a clean trapezoid, i.e. correct modulation.
